cases.d: Verify attendance access and private fields are decided by the server.
steps: GET /api/meetings/<id>/attendance without authentication.
As an outsider, GET /attendance?page=-1.
As the Member, the Chair and the Secretary, GET /attendance.
As the Member and the Chair, POST /attendance with one entry.
exp: Anonymous: HTTP 401; outsider: HTTP 404.
Member, Chair and Secretary can read (HTTP 200); the Member sees no other person's private details.
Only the Secretary may record; the Member and the Chair get HTTP 403.
pre: An InProgress meeting with Chair, Secretary, Member and one guest.

cases.d: Verify a mixed batch saves each change with its own version and audit, and a no-op keeps the metadata.
steps: As the Secretary, GET /attendance.

POST /attendance with { "entries": [ { "id": "<member seat id>", "kind": "Internal", "attendance": "Present", "expectedVersion": "<token from GET>" }, { "id": "<guest invitation id>", "kind": "Guest", "attendance": "Absent", "expectedVersion": "<token>" } ] }.
Send an entry with the attendance it already has.
exp: Before saving, totals.unmarked is 4.
The save returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG147" ("Lưu điểm danh thành công.") and changedCount 2.
Each changed person has a new version, recorder and time, and an audit entry.
The no-op returns MSG147 and keeps the earlier recorder and time.
pre: An InProgress meeting with Chair, Secretary, Member and one guest.

cases.d: Verify answering the invitation or changing role keeps the attendance token valid.
steps: As the Secretary, mark the Member Present.
As the Member, accept the invitation; as the Secretary, change the Member's role to Secretary.
Save the Member's attendance with the token from before these changes.
exp: The response and role changes succeed (MSG105, MSG100).
The attendance save with the earlier token is accepted (HTTP 200, MSG147).
pre: An InProgress meeting with a Member.

cases.d: Verify the attendance body is validated strictly.
steps: As the Secretary, POST /attendance with each body: {}; entries []; entries [null]; entries null; entries twice; an extra actorId; []; an entry with id "invalid".
exp: Each request returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG148" ("Thông tin điểm danh không hợp lệ. Chọn Có mặt hoặc Vắng cho từng người ...").
pre: An InProgress meeting and its Secretary signed in.

steps: POST an entry with: kind "internal" (wrong case); attendance "Unknown"; the empty id; the same entry twice; no expectedVersion; attendance 1 (a number).
exp: Each request returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG148".
No attendance changes.
pre: An InProgress meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify attendance can be recorded only while the meeting is InProgress.
steps: For a Draft, WaitingApproval, Rejected, Approved, Published and Ended meeting, as the Secretary POST one attendance entry, then GET /attendance.
exp: Each save returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG149" ("Chỉ được điểm danh khi cuộc họp đang diễn ra.").
permissions.canRecordAttendance is false.
pre: One meeting per status with a Secretary and a Member.

cases.d: Verify legacy values are shown separately and can be corrected without rewriting others.
steps: Set the Member to Excused and the guest to Delegated (legacy values) and deactivate the Member.
GET /attendance?pageSize=1.
Correct the guest to Present.
exp: totals.legacy is 2 and the legacy values are shown as they are.
The correction saves only the guest; the Member keeps the legacy value.
pre: An InProgress meeting with a Member and a guest.

cases.d: Verify a corrupt stored attendance is reported, not shown as unmarked.
steps: In psql set the Member's attendance to "Corrupt" (then "999", then "present").
As the Secretary, GET /attendance.
exp: HTTP 500 with code "MSG289" ("Không tải được dữ liệu điểm danh.").
The stored value is left as it is.

cases.d: Verify a database failure at commit rolls back the updates, versions and audit together.
steps: Add a deferred trigger that fails when an attendance audit row is committed.
As the Secretary, save the Member and the guest as Present.
exp: HTTP 503 with code "MSG150".
Neither attendance, version nor audit row is saved.
pre: An InProgress meeting with a guest on PostgreSQL.

cases.d: Verify a save failure rolls back the batch while a realtime failure keeps the commit.
steps: Make the save fail and record two entries.
Make only the realtime push fail and record them again.
exp: Save failure: HTTP 503 with code "MSG150"; versions stay 0 and no audit row exists.
Push failure: HTTP 200 with code "MSG147"; the attendance is saved.
pre: An InProgress meeting with a Member and a guest.

cases.d: Verify a chunked request cannot bypass the body size limit.

req.as: Content-Type: application/json; Transfer-Encoding: chunked; Authorization: Bearer <access token of the meeting Secretary>

exp: HTTP 413 with code "MSG87".
pre: An InProgress meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify read failures, bad queries, media type, size and wrong ids have stable codes.
steps: Make the guest profile read fail and GET /attendance.
GET /attendance with page=0, page=1&page=2, pageSize=101, q=x, page=-1, page=2147483648.
POST /attendance with a text/plain body, then with an oversized body, then with ids of another meeting.
exp: Read failure: HTTP 500 with code "MSG289".
Each bad query: HTTP 400 with code "MSG278" ("Tham số phân trang điểm danh không hợp lệ.").
text/plain: HTTP 415 with code "MSG34"; oversized: HTTP 413 with code "MSG87"; wrong ids: HTTP 400 with code "MSG148".
pre: An InProgress meeting and its Secretary signed in.
